q: When a substance is heated, its volume usually increases. This phenomenon is known as _____.
e: When a substance is heated, its volume usually increases. This phenomenon is known as thermal expansion. Most objects grow when they warm because the molecules move harder.

q: The increase in size of a heated substance can be explained in terms of the increased _____ energy of the molecules.
e: The increase in size of a heated substance can be explained in terms of the increased kinetic energy of the molecules. Kinetic here means energy a body has because it is moving. Potential: stored energy due to position or shape.

q: The dependence of the change in length of an object on its original length and change in temperature is $\Delta l = $ _____.
e: The dependence of the change in length of an object on its original length and change in temperature is $\Delta l = $ $\alpha l \Delta T$. Temperature tells you the hotness. Heat tells you energy transferred.

q: In the linear expansion formula, $\alpha$ represents the coefficient of _____ expansion.
e: In the linear expansion formula, $\alpha$ represents the coefficient of linear expansion. The physics in this sentence is built around linear.

q: The unit of the coefficient of linear expansion $\alpha$ is per K, which can be written as _____.
e: The unit of the coefficient of linear expansion $\alpha$ is per K, which can be written as $K^{-1}$. Most objects grow when they warm because the molecules move harder.

q: The coefficient of linear expansion is the change in length per _____ length for one degree change in temperature.
e: The coefficient of linear expansion is the change in length per unit length for one degree change in temperature. Unit here means an agreed amount you use as the scale of a measurement.

q: The relation for area expansion is $\Delta A = $ _____.
e: The relation for area expansion is $\Delta A = $ $\beta A \Delta T$. The physics in this sentence is built around $\beta A \Delta T$.

q: In the area expansion equation, $\beta$ is the coefficient of _____ expansion.
e: In the area expansion equation, $\beta$ is the coefficient of area expansion. The physics in this sentence is built around area.

q: The relation for volume expansion is $\Delta V = $ _____.
e: The relation for volume expansion is $\Delta V = $ $\gamma V \Delta T$. The physics in this sentence is built around $\gamma V \Delta T$.

q: The coefficient of volume expansion of a substance is the change in volume per _____ volume for one degree change in temperature.
e: The coefficient of volume expansion of a substance is the change in volume per unit volume for one degree change in temperature. Unit here means an agreed amount you use as the scale of a measurement.

q: Generally all substances expand on heating and contract on cooling, but water shows _____ expansion.
e: Generally all substances expand on heating and contract on cooling, but water shows anomalous expansion. The physics in this sentence is built around anomalous.

q: When water at 0°C is heated, its volume decreases up to _____ and density increases.
e: When water at 0°C is heated, its volume decreases up to 4°C and density increases. Density compares mass with the space that mass occupies.

q: At 4°C, the _____ of water becomes maximum.
e: At 4°C, the density of water becomes maximum. Density here means mass per unit volume.
